bundle.shortDescription: Disk and memory cleaner for developers
bundle.longDescription: Jetsam finds the regenerable junk a development Mac accumulates (package caches, node_modules, build outputs, stale worktrees, simulator data, logs) and removes it with a preview first and the Trash by default. It also watches memory pressure and reclaims RAM from leaked helpers and headless browsers without touching what you are working on.
